raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "26.11.0"

package:
  name: scipp
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/scipp/scipp/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3e6bff5e865bba453c0ba6ec21f3fbfc41c10435cdc7d22813eed65ac471a354

build:
  number: 0
  skip: match(python, "<3.12")
  script:
    env:
      GIT_VERSION_INFO: ${{ version }}
    content:
      - if: win
        then: cmake --preset package-${{ target_platform }} -DPython_EXECUTABLE="%PYTHON%" -DCONDA_FORGE_BUILD=ON
      - if: unix
        then: cmake --preset package-${{ target_platform }} -DPython_EXECUTABLE="$PYTHON" -DCONDA_FORGE_BUILD=ON ${CMAKE_ARGS}
      - cmake --build --preset build
      - if: build_platform == target_platform
        then: ctest --preset test
  dynamic_linking:
    overlinking_behavior: error

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - python
    - cmake
    - ninja
  host:
    - python
    - tbb-devel
    - libboost-headers
    - eigen
    - pybind11 3.0.*
    - gmock
    - gtest
  run:
    - numpy >=2
    - python
    - tbb
  ignore_run_exports:
    by_name:
      - gtest  # Used only by the C++ tests.

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - scipp
      pip_check: false
  - script:
      - python -m pytest -v tests
    requirements:
      run:
        - numba
        - bs4
        - h5py
        - hypothesis
        - pandas
        - pytest
        - python-graphviz
        - xarray
        - ipython
        - scipy >=1.7.0
    files:
      source:
        - pyproject.toml
        - tests/

about:
  homepage: https://scipp.github.io/
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - LLNL_UNITS_LICENSE
  summary: Multi-dimensional data arrays with labeled dimensions
  description: Multi-dimensional data arrays with labeled dimensions
  repository: https://github.com/scipp/scipp
  documentation: https://scipp.github.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MridulS
    - jl-wynen
    - SimonHeybrock
    - YooSunYoung
    - jokasimr
    - nvaytet
